procedure: Start from a clean dependency install and run npm run verify.
Open Workbench, edit one physical input, solve, and inspect source-labelled metrics.
Step one exact frame, export the scenario, reload offline, and re-import it.
Open Designer, change a measured bike dimension, and verify a worker-returned pose sample after changing a distance key.
Open Report and compare the accessible table with the deterministic charts.
Review physics limitations, compatibility report, browser matrix, and decision record.
note: Completion and duration require a real independent reviewer and are not inferred from automated tests.
